A2Analogue

Dual LFO

Two LFOs with four waveforms each

Two independent, identical LFOs. Each one outputs triangle, square, saw and sine simultaneously.

  • Rate from about 0.07 Hz to 50 Hz, CV controllable
  • SHAPE shifts the symmetry from falling to rising ramp
  • Bicolour LEDs show the waveform
Width10 HP · 50.6 mm
Height3U · 128.5 mm
Jacks12
Knobs4
